title: Champions Left The Stanley Cup On The Roadside 🏆
caption:
Champions left the Stanley Cup on the side of the road 🏆
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In 1924 the Montreal Canadiens left the Stanley Cup on a curb while helping push a car, and went back hours later to find it still there. In 1907 the trophy was even used as a flower pot for months after the Montreal Wanderers left it at a photographer's home.
Where would YOU have left it? 👇
first_comment: It sat on a curb for hours and nobody took it. Do you trust your city that much? 🏆👇
